SELECT x.group_id AS group_id, x.group_code AS group_code, x.bucket_start AS bucket_start, COUNT(*) AS sample_count, MIN(x.pressure_mpa) AS pressure_min, MAX(x.pressure_mpa) AS pressure_max, AVG(x.pressure_mpa) AS pressure_avg, AVG(x.temperature_c) AS temperature_avg, AVG(x.flow_m3h) AS flow_avg FROM ( SELECT t.well_group_id AS group_id, g.group_code AS group_code, t.pressure_mpa AS pressure_mpa, t.temperature_c AS temperature_c, t.flow_m3h AS flow_m3h, DATEADD('SECOND', FLOOR((EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.reading_time) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM t.reading_time) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM t.reading_time)) / #{p.bucketSeconds}) * #{p.bucketSeconds}, CAST(t.reading_time AS DATE)) AS bucket_start FROM t_wellhead_telemetry t INNER JOIN t_well_group g ON g.id = t.well_group_id
) x GROUP BY x.group_id, x.group_code, x.bucket_start ORDER BY x.group_id ASC, x.bucket_start ASC
